literal_meaning: ফাঁক দিয়ে জুঁকি দেওয়া (peeking through gaps or crevices)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ফাঁকিজুঁকি করে সবাইকে ধোঁকা দিল।
ফাঁকিজুঁকি দিয়ে আর কাজ চালানো যাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He deceived everyone with his sneaky tricks.
You can't keep getting away with hypocritical behavior.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of secretive, underhanded actions, common in Bengali folklore and daily expressions.
